description: Generate text with an open-source model hosted on Groq, on the server's key — no API key needed. Models: openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b (default "openai/gpt-oss-20b"). HuggingFace models are not served on the server key. A reasoning model that spends max_tokens thinking is retried once at 4096. Rate-limited to prevent abuse.

model.description: Model ID (default: "openai/gpt-oss-20b"). Server-keyed whitelist only — Groq: openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b. Other ids from list_llm_models, HuggingFace ones included, are BYOK-only and will be rejected.

prompt.description: The user prompt / instruction to send to the model

system.description: Optional system prompt to set context or persona

name: llm_generate
